question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, and Eve are holding a white elephant gift exchange. At the start of the event, they are each holding a present of a different color: Alice has a silver present, Bob has a gold present, Claire has a white present, Dave has a teal present, and Eve has a green present.
As the event progresses, pairs of people swap gifts. First, Claire and Bob swap their gifts. Then, Claire and Alice swap their gifts. Then, Bob and Dave swap their gifts. Then, Claire and Eve swap their gifts. Finally, Eve and Dave swap their gifts. At the end of the event, Bob has the
Options:
(A) silver present
(B) gold present
(C) white present
(D) teal present
(E) green present
solution:
Gift colors are listed in the order (Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve).
Initial: (silver, gold, white, teal, green)
1. Claire swaps with Bob: (silver, white, gold, teal, green)
2. Claire swaps with Alice: (gold, white, silver, teal, green)
3. Bob swaps with Dave: (gold, teal, silver, white, green)
4. Claire swaps with Eve: (gold, teal, green, white, silver)
5. Eve swaps with Dave: (gold, teal, green, silver, white)
Bob has the teal present, option (D).
Final answer: (D)
